scanNote:
WORKBOOK 34-BET. Unit 8 — miqdor so'zlari, ovqat buyurtma qilish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 8-mashq (11 bo'shliq), 9-mashq (10 tuzatish), 10-mashq (7 juftlik), 11a (4 sarlavha), 11b (4 savol), 11c (3 dialog), 12-mashq (tartibga solish) — jami 39 ta javob.

⚠ 8-MAShQ 3-BAND NOZIK: 'HOW MUCH are the chicken sandwiches?' — sendvich SANALADI, lekin bu yerda NARX so'ralyapti, shuning uchun 'how much'. 'How many' bo'lsa soni so'ralgan bo'lardi.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — O'N XATO, BESh TURI:
  sanalmaydigan otga artikl: 'a milk' → SOME milk; 'an bread' → SOME bread
  sanaladigan otga 'some' birlikda: 'some orange' → AN orange; 'some apple' → AN apple
  how much / how many almashtirilgan (3, 7, 9-band)
  much / many almashtirilgan (4-band)
  'many fish' → SOME fish (bu yerda 'fish' ovqat sifatida sanalmaydi)
  ⚠ 1-band boshqacha: 'some glass of Coke' → A glass ('glass' o'lchov so'zi, birlikda).

⚠ 10-MAShQ — YETTI JUFTLIK, YETTI QOIDA:
  1a — taklifda 'Would you like SOME...?' ('Do you like some' xato)
  2b — savolda ANYTHING ('something' emas)
  3a — 'I don't like fish' (yoqtirmaslikni oddiy zamon bildiradi)
  4b — 'I like pizza' (umumiy yoqtirish — birlik, artiklsiz)
  5b va 6b — narx: 'How MUCH is that?' va 'How much DOES IT COST?' (savolda 'do' shart)
  7a — inkorda ANY

⚠ 11a — MENYU TO'RT QISMGA BO'LINADI: Starters (sho'rva, salat) · Main courses (baliq, bifshteks, tovuq) · Desserts (muzqaymoq, pirog, qulupnay) · Drinks (sharob, pivo, mineral suv, qahva).
  ⚠ 11b dagi to'rt savol ham aynan shu tartibda beriladi — ofitsiantning ish tartibi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in how much, how many, a few, a little, some or any.
exercises.instructionUz: how much, how many, a few, a little, some yoki any qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
ASOSIY JADVAL:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plik)      SANALMAYDIGAN
     how many                  how much
     a few                     a little

  SOME → tasdiq gap, TAKLIF va ILTIMOS savoli
  ANY  → inkor gap va MA'LUMOT savoli

DIQQAT — 'HOW MUCH ARE ...?' NARX SAVOLI:
  'How much ARE the sandwiches?' = ular qancha turadi?
  Narx uchun DOIM 'how much', hatto ot ko'plikda bo'lsa ham.
  Fe'l esa otga moslashadi: ARE the sandwiches.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ apples do you need, sir?
items.whyUz: 'apples' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
SANALADIGAN → A FEW.

items.textEn: 2  A: Would you like ............ milk in your coffee, madam?
items.whyUz: 'Would you like ...?' — TAKLIF (offer) → SOME.

'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.
'only a little' = atigi bir oz.

NARX so'rash uchun DOIM 'HOW MUCH ...?'
Ot ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun fe'l ARE:
  'How much ARE the sandwiches?'
DIQQAT: 'How many are ...?' — narx uchun ISHLATILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 3  B: I'm sorry. We haven't got ............ chicken sandwiches left.
items.whyUz:
INKOR gap ('haven't got') → ANY.
'left' = qolgan.

items.textEn: 4  A: Mum, can I have ............ orange juice?
items.whyUz: 'Can I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) → SOME.

INKOR gap ('There isn't') → ANY.
'There isn't any left' = hech narsa qolmadi.

items.textEn: 5  A: John, have we got ............ bananas?
items.whyUz:
'Have we got ...?' — MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY.
2 va 4-band bilan solishtiring: ular taklif/iltimos edi → SOME.

items.textEn: 5  B: Yes, but there are only ............ .
items.whyUz:
'bananas' — SANALADIGAN → A FEW.
'only a few' = atigi bir nechta.

'bananas' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
Javob: 'About five' — son bilan, demak sanaladigan.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  I'd like SOME glass of Coke, please.  →  A

XATO TURLARI:

  1) Miqdor so'zi oldida 'some' ortiqcha
       some glass → A glass

  2) 'a/an' sanalmaydigan ot bilan
       an bread → SOME bread
       a milk → SOME milk

  3) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many does this cost? → How MUCH
       How much cherries? → How MANY
       How many sugar? → How MUCH

  4) MUCH / MANY noto'g'ri
       much tomatoes → MANY tomatoes

  5) 'many' o'rniga 'some' kerak
       many fish → SOME fish

  6) Sanaladigan BIRLIK oldida 'some'
       some orange → AN orange
       some apple → AN apple

items.textEn: 1  I'd like some glass of Coke, please. → ............
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: 'some' → 'a'.
'a glass of Coke' — MIQDOR iborasi oldida 'a' turadi.
'some glass' XATO.

'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'an' ISHLATILMAYDI.
TAKLIF savoli → SOME bread.

NARX uchun DOIM 'How MUCH does it cost?'
'How many' — son uchun.

'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → MANY.
'much' faqat sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.

items.textEn: 5  I'd like a milk in my tea, please. → ............
items.whyUz:
'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
TASDIQ gap → SOME milk.
(Yoki: 'a little milk' — 8-mashqning 2-bandi kabi.)

items.textEn: 6  Could I have some orange, please? → ............
items.whyUz:
'an orange' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK (bitta apelsin).
Unli tovush → AN.
DIQQAT: 'some orange JUICE' bo'lsa to'g'ri bo'lardi —
lekin bu yerda faqat 'orange' bor.

items.textEn: 7  How much cherries do you need? → ............
items.whyUz: 'cherries' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

items.textEn: 8  I'd like many fish for lunch. → ............
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gapda 'many' odatda ISHLATILMAYDI → SOME.
'fish' — ovqat sifatida SANALMAYDIGAN.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME fish for lunch.

items.textEn: 9  How many sugar have we got? → ............
items.whyUz: 'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

'an apple' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK.
Unli tovush → AN.
6-band bilan bir xil xato turi.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.

TEKSHIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  • TAKLIF savolida 'Would you like' (Do you like emas)
  • Savolda 'anything' (something emas)
  • Rad etishda 'I don't like ...'
  • 'I like + sanalmaydigan/umumiy ot' (birlik)
  • NARX uchun 'How much'
  • Savolda DO/DOES yordamchi fe'li shart
  • INKOR gapda ANY

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1a to'g'ri.

options: a  Would you like some ice-cream?
b  Do you like some ice-cream?
items.answer: a  Would you like some ice-cream?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob.
TAKLIF savolida 'WOULD you like ...?' — 'some' bilan keladi.

options: b  Is there anything to drink?
a  Is there something to drink?
items.answer: b  Is there anything to drink?
items.whyUz:
SAVOLDA 'anything' ishlatiladi ('something' emas).
Coursebook 56-betda ham shu ibora bor edi.
'something' — TASDIQ gapda: 'There is something to drink.'

options: a  No thanks. I don't like fish.
items.answer: a  No thanks. I don't like fish.
items.whyUz:
Rad etishda SABAB 'I don't like ...' bilan aytiladi.
'I wouldn't like fish' — tabiiy ingliz tilida ishlatilmaydi.
Coursebook 56-betdagi dialoglarda ham 'I don't like ...' bor edi.

'I like pizza' = pitsani yoqtiraman (umuman) — TO'G'RI.
'I'd like pizzas' — buyurtmada 'some pizzas' yoki 'a pizza' bo'lishi kerak,
yalang'och ko'plik ishlatilmaydi.

NARX uchun DOIM 'How much is that?'
Coursebook 56-betdagi do'kon dialogida ham bor edi.

options: b  How much does it cost?
items.answer: b  How much does it cost?
items.whyUz:
Present Simple savolida DOES yordamchi fe'li SHART.
'does' bor bo'lsa asosiy fe'lga -S QO'ShILMAYDI: 'does it COST'.

options: a  There isn't any Coke in the fridge.
b  There isn't some Coke in the fridge.
items.answer: a  There isn't any Coke in the fridge.
items.whyUz:
INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi.
'There isn't SOME' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the restaurant menu and fill in drinks, starters, desserts and main courses.
exercises.instructionUz: Restoran menyusiga qarang va drinks, starters, desserts hamda main courses so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MENYU TO'RT BO'LIMDAN IBORAT:

  STARTERS (birinchi taomlar):
     Tomato soup      £2.50
     Onion soup       £2.50
     Garden salad     £3.00

  MAIN COURSES (asosiy taomlar):
     Grilled fish with rice        £4.99
     Pepper steak with potatoes    £7.00
     Roast chicken with carrots    £5.75

  DESSERTS (shirinliklar):
     Ice-cream                 £2.75
     Apple pie                 £2.75
     Strawberries and cream    £3.00

  DRINKS (ichimliklar):
     Wine             £2.00
     Beer             £2.00
     Mineral water    £1.50
     Coffee           £1.50

OVQAT TARTIBI (Britaniya restoranida):
  1) starter — yengil birinchi taom (sho'rva, salat)
  2) main course — asosiy taom (go'sht, baliq)
  3) dessert — shirinlik
  4) drinks — ichimlik (ovqat davomida)

items.textEn: 1-bo'lim: Tomato soup £2.50, Onion soup £2.50, Garden salad £3.00
items.hintUz: Yengil birinchi taomlar — sho'rva va salat
items.whyUz:
'a starter' = birinchi taom (asosiy taomdan OLDIN).
Sho'rva va salat — tipik starterlar.
Coursebook 59-betda ham bor edi: 'To start with I'd like the tomato soup.'

items.textEn: 2-bo'lim: Grilled fish with rice £4.99, Pepper steak with potatoes £7.00, Roast chicken with carrots £5.75
items.whyUz:
'a main course' = asosiy (ikkinchi) taom.
Go'sht va baliq taomlari — eng qimmat bo'limi.
Coursebook 59-betda: 'And for the main course?'

items.textEn: 3-bo'lim: Ice-cream £2.75, Apple pie £2.75, Strawberries and cream £3.00
items.whyUz:
'a dessert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik.
Muzqaymoq, pirog, qulupnay — hammasi shirinlik.

'drinks' = ichimliklar.
Hammasi SANALMAYDIGAN otlar, lekin menyuda porsiya sifatida sotiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the questions, then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni qo'ying, so'ng juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR RO'YXATI:
  And for the main course
  What would you like to drink
  Would you like some dessert
  What would you like to start

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  W: WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO START?
  C: I'd like a garden salad, please.
  W: Okay. AND FOR THE MAIN COURSE?
  C: Can I have the roast chicken with carrots, please?
  W: Excellent choice. WOULD YOU LIKE SOME DESSERT?
  C: I'll have some apple pie, please.
  W: WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO DRINK?
  C: A cup of coffee, please.
  W: Thank you, sir.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  W: Birinchi taomga nima olasiz?
  C: Bog' salatini olsam, iltimos.
  W: Yaxshi. Asosiy taomga-chi?
  C: Sabzili qovurilgan tovuq olsam bo'ladimi?
  W: Ajoyib tanlov. Shirinlik xohlaysizmi?
  C: Olmali pirogdan olaman, iltimos.
  W: Nima ichasiz?
  C: Bir piyola qahva, iltimos.
  W: Rahmat, janob.

W = the waiter (ofitsiant)
C = the customer (mijoz)

SAVOLLAR TARTIBI MENYU TARTIBI BILAN BIR XIL:
  starter → main course → dessert → drink

YANGI IBORA:
  Excellent choice! = Ajoyib tanlov!
  I'll have ... = Men ... olaman (buyurtma berish)

lines.answer: What would you like to start
lines.hintUz: Javob: 'I'd like a garden salad' — bu qaysi bo'lim?
lines.whyUz:
Javob SALAT — bu STARTER (birinchi taom).
'What would you like to start?' = birinchi taomga nima olasiz?

lines.textEn: I'd like a garden salad, please.

lines.hintUz: Javob: qovurilgan tovuq — bu qaysi bo'lim?
lines.whyUz:
Javob QOVURILGAN TOVUQ — bu MAIN COURSE.
'And for the main course?' — Coursebook 59-betda ham bor edi.

lines.textEn: Can I have the roast chicken with carrots, please?

lines.hintUz: Javob: olmali pirog — bu qaysi bo'lim?
lines.whyUz:
Javob OLMALI PIROG — bu DESSERT.
TAKLIF savoli → 'Would you like SOME dessert?'

lines.textEn: I'll have some apple pie, please.

lines.answer: What would you like to drink
lines.whyUz:
Javob QAHVA — bu DRINK.
'What would you like to drink?' = nima ichasiz?

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MENYUDAGI BOSHQA TAOMLARDAN FOYDALANING:
  Starters: tomato soup, onion soup, garden salad
  Main courses: grilled fish with rice,
                pepper steak with potatoes,
                roast chicken with carrots
  Desserts: ice-cream, apple pie, strawberries and cream
  Drinks: wine, beer, mineral water, coffee

BUYURTMA BERISH SHAKLLARI (hammasi to'g'ri):
  I'd like ... , please.
  Can I have ... , please?
  I'll have ... , please.

items.prompt: tomato soup → pepper steak → ice-cream → wine
items.question: What would you like to start? — And for the main course? — Would you like some dessert? — What would you like to drink?
items.answer: I'd like the tomato soup, please. — Can I have the pepper steak with potatoes, please? — I'll have some ice-cream, please. — A glass of wine, please.
items.whyUz:
Jami: £2.50 + £7.00 + £2.75 + £2.00 = £14.25
'a glass of wine' — miqdor iborasi.

items.prompt: onion soup → grilled fish → strawberries and cream → mineral water
items.question: What would you like to start? — And for the main course? — Would you like some dessert? — What would you like to drink?
items.answer: I'd like the onion soup, please. — Can I have the grilled fish with rice, please? — I'll have some strawberries and cream, please. — A bottle of mineral water, please.
items.whyUz:
Jami: £2.50 + £4.99 + £3.00 + £1.50 = £11.99
'strawberries and cream' — turg'un birikma (32-bet).

items.prompt: garden salad → roast chicken → apple pie → beer
items.question: What would you like to start? — And for the main course? — Would you like some dessert? — What would you like to drink?
items.answer: I'd like a garden salad, please. — Can I have the roast chicken with carrots, please? — I'll have some apple pie, please. — A beer, please.
items.whyUz:
Jami: £3.00 + £5.75 + £2.75 + £2.00 = £13.50
Eng arzon variant emas, lekin muvozanatli.

exercises.instructionEn: The following dialogue is in jumbled order. Put the sentences in the correct order, then act out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialog aralashtirib berilgan. Gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring, so'ng dialogni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ARALASHTIRILGAN GAPLAR:
  B: Thank you.
  B: Good evening. Have you got a table for four?
  A: Would you like to see the menu?
  A: Good evening, sir.
  B: Yes, please.
  A: Yes, sir. Over here, near the fireplace.

QANDAY TARTIBLASH:
  1) Kim BIRINCHI gapiradi? — ofitsiant salomlashadi
  2) Har bir gap oldingisiga JAVOB bo'lishi kerak
  3) A va B navbat bilan gapiradi

TO'G'RI TARTIB:
  1  A: Good evening, sir.
  2  B: Good evening. Have you got a table for four?
  3  A: Yes, sir. Over here, near the fireplace.
  4  B: Thank you.
  5  A: Would you like to see the menu?
  6  B: Yes, please.

MANTIQ:
  salomlashish → stol so'rash → stol ko'rsatish →
  rahmat → menyu taklif qilish → rozilik

A = the waiter (ofitsiant)
B = the customer (mijoz)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Over here = mana bu yerda
  a fireplace = kamin (Grammar Book 28-betda ham bor edi)

items.whyUz: Ofitsiant BIRINCHI salomlashadi — mijoz kirganda.

items.en: Good evening. Have you got a table for four?
items.uz: Xayrli kech. To'rt kishilik stolingiz bormi?
items.whyUz:
Mijoz salomga javob beradi va stol so'raydi.
'a table for four' = to'rt kishilik stol.

items.en: Yes, sir. Over here, near the fireplace.
items.uz: Ha, janob. Mana bu yerda, kamin yonida.
items.whyUz:
Ofitsiant stol borligini tasdiqlaydi va joyni ko'rsatadi.
'Over here' = mana bu yerda; 'a fireplace' = kamin.
Mijoz minnatdorchilik bildiradi.

items.en: Would you like to see the menu?
items.whyUz:
Ofitsiant menyu taklif qiladi.
Coursebook 59-betda ham bor edi: 'Would you like to look at the menu?'

Mijoz taklifni QABUL QILADI.
Qabul → PLEASE (rad → THANKS).

groups.explanationUz: Britaniya restoranida ovqat shu tartibda beriladi.

items.base: Have you got a table for four?
Would you like to see the menu?

groups.explanationUz: SOME/ANY qoidasi bu olmoshlarga ham tegishli.

patterns.formula: How much ARE + ko'plik ot?  (narx savoli)
patterns.exampleEn: How much are the chicken sandwiches?
patterns.explanationUz:
NARX uchun DOIM 'how much', hatto ot ko'plikda bo'lsa ham.
Fe'l esa otga moslashadi: ARE.

patterns.exampleEn: Sorry. There isn't any left. We haven't got any chicken sandwiches left.
patterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz. Hech narsa qolmadi. Tovuqli sendvich qolmadi.

patterns.formula: What would you like TO START / TO DRINK?
patterns.exampleEn: What would you like to start? What would you like to drink?
patterns.exampleUz: Birinchi taomga nima olasiz? Nima ichasiz?

patterns.formula: And for the MAIN COURSE?  /  Would you like some DESSERT?
patterns.exampleEn: And for the main course? Would you like some dessert?

patterns.formula: Have you got a table FOR + son?
patterns.exampleEn: Have you got a table for four?

patterns.formula: Is there ANYTHING to eat/drink?  (savolda anything)
